text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yo, get this—today's my birthday too!That makes us frontrunner twins andtwin twins—how cool is that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We thought we might as well<n>celebrate together, so
we went<n>looking for ya.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha. I'm always busy with my<n>part-time jobs,
so I appreciate the<n>chance to have some fun with
y'all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real, everything's more hype<n>together! Let's
get some good vibes<n>going! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's it, now you're vibing! Now we<n>gotta keep
the energy up all night!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Common sense, what's that? Tonight<n>is our
getaway. ♪ 'Cause we the<n>birthday twins, the life
of the<n>partaaay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right! C'mon Ines, ride the rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Is it just me... or did I just get<n>dragged into
something even more<n>demanding than work...)
